title: Investment Committee Memorandum
purpose: Support a disciplined investment decision with thesis, diligence evidence, downside analysis and explicit decision request.

sections.title: Decision Requested
sections.instruction: Amount, instrument, stage, valuation/terms if known, approval sought and decision deadline.

sections.title: Investment Thesis
sections.instruction: Core reasons to invest, evidence supporting each, and what must be true for the thesis to work.

sections.title: Company and Product
sections.instruction: Entity, ownership, product scope, maturity, customer and strategic position.

sections.title: Market and Competitive Position
sections.instruction: Market sizing, segmentation, adoption, competition, substitutes and source quality.

sections.title: Technology and IP Diligence
sections.instruction: Architecture, technical differentiation, validation, IP chain of title, open-source obligations and dependencies.

sections.title: Commercial Diligence
sections.instruction: Customer interviews, contracts, pilots, pricing evidence, sales cycle and pipeline quality.

sections.title: Financial Analysis
sections.instruction: Historicals if available, forecast scenarios, unit economics, cash needs, dilution, runway and sensitivities.

sections.title: Team and Governance
sections.instruction: Founder-market fit, execution record, gaps, incentives, governance and key-person dependency.

sections.title: Risk and Mitigation
sections.instruction: Ranked risks, red flags, unresolved diligence and mitigations.

sections.title: Return Scenarios and Exit Considerations
sections.instruction: Show scenario logic and assumptions; avoid false precision or promised returns.

sections.title: Recommendation and Conditions
sections.instruction: Invest / decline / defer, rationale, conditions precedent, milestones, covenants and monitoring.

sections.title: Diligence Record
sections.instruction: Sources, interview notes, model, cap table, legal/IP review, technical reports and data-room index.
